summary: Steel fire tower built 1923 at Long Hill, Pasadena, Anne Arundel County, MD; DNR notice proposes demolition, and we found no confirmed removal.

facts.design: steel tower; height sources disagree (60 ft and 110 ft)
facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts list shows it standing; a DNR notice with comments due Sept 30, 2025 proposes demolition, and we found no report that it has been taken down

staffing.status: not in use as a lookout

events.note: 60-foot steel tower erected and ready for service in 1923 (Forest Lookouts quoting a state report); DNR also dates the tower to 1923
Short-wave radio test set installed in the Long Hill tower; contact made with a forest warden's automobile (newspaper quoted by Forest Lookouts)
MHT determined demolition would have an adverse effect on historic properties; DNR asked for comments by September 30, 2025

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts list shows the tower standing, while DNR's notice proposes demolition. We found no report that it was taken down, so we keep standing and flag the condition as unconfirmed.

notes_for_editor: Height is unresolved: Forest Lookouts quotes a 60-foot steel tower (we store 18.3 m from that), while the DNR Kitty Shortall page says 110 feet. Demolition: the DNR notice gives no removal date and a web search found no confirmation either way, so recheck DNR Forest Service before the status changes. The 1934 radio item is quoted from a newspaper via Forest Lookouts; we did not read the original. Kitty Shortall's start date is only 'late 1950s' in the sources, so no year-dated staffing event is recorded. The brief lacked an agency, which we took from the DNR notice. A web search hit on a different Long Hill (Wetipquin, Wikipedia) was ignored. No photos were added.
